proposed_widenings.name: area.shape.cone
proposed_widenings.justification: The area attachment shape is a closed union containing only 'sphere'. Cone of Cold projects a 60-foot cone originating from the caster. No honest approximation with sphere exists — the geometry is fundamentally different and affects which creatures are targeted.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each creature in a 60-foot Cone originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw

proposed_widenings.name: AreaOrigin.self_emanation
proposed_widenings.justification: AreaOrigin has two variants: point_within_range and on_primary_target. Cone of Cold's area emanates from the caster's own position (spell range is Self). Neither existing variant captures a self-originating area; point_within_range implies a chosen point, not the caster's body.

proposed_widenings.name: Effect.half_of_fail
proposed_widenings.justification: The on-success branch deals exactly half the fail damage, which scales with slot upcasting. Effect = DamageEffect | NoneEffect, and DamageEffect holds a DiceExpr (integer dice/dieSize/flat). Half of 8d8 is 4d8 at base, but the per-slot increment is +1d8 fail → +0.5d8 success, which is not representable as integer dice counts. Encoding success as a separate DiceAmount would be dishonest about the scaling relationship.
proposed_widenings.evidence: taking 8d8 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.

notes: Core activation/save_gate/area-damage pattern fits the family. Three surface-level gaps block honest encoding without new variants. No new v4 atoms are required — all needed atoms (spell_root, activate, action_quota, spell_slot, area, save_gate, damage, scale_die_count) exist in v4. The 'frozen statue' rider (creature killed becomes a frozen statue until it thaws) is a narrative/DM-owned effect with no deterministic mechanical resolution for surviving combatants and is legitimately out of core scope. Omitting it is honest.
